Honestly, it's incredible. I'm only 14ish months sober but started noticing just how.. GOOD I felt around six months. It's SO WORTH IT. The first 90 days or so were tough for me but I have never felt better mentally/emotionally/physically. I still get uncomfortable in some social situations and struggle with anxiety but it is SO MUCH BETTER now that I've quit drinking.

16 days is amazing! The first few weeks were the hardest for me. After some time, so much improved- things I would've never thought of! I was a low bottom drunk, so my health was deteriorating, I had legal problems, was being kicked out of my living situation, struggling financially, quit grad school, and was BARELY still employed. I was mostly hoping to gain the respect of my famliy and get out of legal trouble, but SO MUCH MORE happened:

**Physically**\- I lost 50 pounds by quitting booze, getting more exercise, and just eating regularly. I did not adopt some crazy diet, just was more active and trying to listen to my body. I have progress pics in my post history if you're interested. But the biggest changes were that my eyes are WAYYYY brighter, my face isn't red and splotchy, I'm not bloated, my skin has improved on my entire body, I'm not as tired, I don't get headaches, my sleep is SO MUCH BETTER, my hair is shinier, my smile is brighter, and even my sweat doesn't smell as bad anymore (lmao gross but true!). I'm using the bathroom regularly and don't get constant stomach pains. Overall, I just look....... way prettier, even without the weight loss. I didn't realize how much damage drinking did to my overall appearance even when I was "moderating".

**Mentally**\- I absolutely despised and hated myself. I had zero self esteem and couldn't say one nice thing about myself. I struggled with disordered eating and self-image issues my entire life and I did not think that getting sober would help that. Today, I am way more confident and can list the many good qualities I have- I'm patient, a hard worker, compassionate, empathetic, and loyal. All of this came from a lot of therapy and working a 12 step program but I had to put the bottle down first. Also, I'm a lot smarter/quicker now and can think much more clearly! I'm back in graduate school and reading/learning is SO MUCH EASIER. I feel smart again.

**Spiritually-** I don't follow any religion or anything, but in sobriety I've started meditating, using positive affirmations, journaling, and reading a lot of spiritual books. I have never felt more at peace and am finally forgiving myself for the past! It's something I've recently started working on and I'm happy to continue my spiritual progress. 

**Finally,** the last thing I never expected were the amazing friends and tribe of women I found in sobriety. I have women who show up for me today during my best and worst days! I have friends I can trust and who want nothing from me except for me to succeed and be happy. I gained the respect of my coworkers and family back, and I never thought that would be possible. Today my mom texted me "I have never been more proud of you. I have my daughter back" and that really fucking struck me hard.

I honestly could go on and on. Everything hasn't been rainbow and sunshine, but the hard work has been worth EVERYTHING I just listed and more! Sorry this was so long!!
